title: Hello-World with sep
description:
Print `Hello` and `World` on the same line with a dash between them and no spaces, using the `sep` parameter of `print()`.

**Expected output:**
```
Hello-World
```
starterCode:
# Use the sep parameter to control the separator
print("Hello", "World", sep=)
hint: The sep parameter controls what appears between arguments. Set sep="-" to use a dash.
